description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456 review F3): an exempt non-event `on…` word (`online=`), a raster `data:image/png` on ``, and `sms:` all interpolate normally.
rationale: §5.2 executable-sink rule: any `on…` attribute is a handler "EXCEPT the named non-event words `one`, `online` and `onboarding`, matched by exact whole name"; "One `data:` shape is admitted: on an image-source attribute … a `data:` URL whose literal text names a complete raster image media type"; `sms:` is in the literal safe-scheme set.
